title: Burkina Faso national grid emission factor
description: CO2 per kWh of SONABEL generation. SONABEL and the regulator (ARSE) publish no grid EF; the country-specific figure is the peer-reviewed 2018 SONABEL generation-mix factor (country-specific HFO/DDO carbon contents). It excludes imports from Cote d'Ivoire and Ghana (~35% of supply) and T&D losses. The same paper reports that the environment ministry (MEEVCC 2018) references a WAPES regional EF of 0.588 for SONABEL's interconnected grid, 3% above. ecoinvent has no BF grid; the matcher falls to the RAF market group (~0.24 kgCO2e/kWh).

regional_reference.what: WAPES regional grid EF referenced to SONABEL's grid by MEEVCC (2018), as cited by Nana et al. (2023).

provenance.table: Abstract and section 'Assessment of the contribution of renewable energies'
provenance.span: The CO2 emission factor for thermal power generation was estimated at 0.663 kg/kWh and that of the electricity generation mix at 0.569 kg/kWh.
